source.normalization: Same as scripts/build-full-level.py: runtime x=(source x-horizontalCenter.x)*0.1; runtime y=source z*0.1; runtime z=-(source y-horizontalCenter.y)*0.1.

player.note: Use the existing AVI plus standalone jetbike model. Do not scale the bike to solve framing.

wardenActor.role: elite rival scale, slightly taller than the rider but not building-sized
wardenActor.note: The supplied Warden model stays at elite-rival scale; do not make a new boss model for this slice.

movement.vertical: E rises, Q lowers; W/S remain horizontal.

anchors.role: real surface spawn beside the bridge split
background landmark only; not the playable start
real upper bridge entry for the high charge route
real upper bridge exit into industrial decks
real lower bridge entry for the shield route
real lower bridge exit before the climb
visual pipe detail beside the lower bridge route
Warden arena from real level surfaces

start.beat: spawn on the real left bridgehead surface

fork.beat: choose the upper or lower bridge route

highRoute.beat: spawn on the real left bridgehead surface
read both bridge routes from the split
line up to the upper bridge approach
enter the real upper bridge west end
hold center across the upper bridge modules
exit the real upper bridge east end
boost across the upper industrial deck
take the exposed charge lane into the court
enter Warden court with charged shots

lowRoute.beat: spawn on the real left bridgehead surface
drop onto the lower bridge approach
enter the real lower bridge west end
hold center across the lower bridge span
exit the real lower bridge east end
climb from the lower bridge toward side cover
follow the side route through industrial cover
gain shield at the cover edge

low.tradeoff: longer route with tighter bridge steering

combat.rule: Only exposed phase takes normal damage; route reward changes the first punish window.

limitations: This is a design path from real model anchors, not yet a runtime collision or acceptance pass.
The cannon is now a background landmark, because raycasts place its playable top far above the bridge route and it forced the old path to float.
The high route uses the real upper bridge modules and nearby decks; the low route uses the real lower bridge modules with pipe assets as visual dressing beside the lane.
Route overlays should be ground-projected decals on traversable surfaces with small rings at choices and rewards; avoid continuous floating debug splines in close-up gameplay views.
The full level remains visual context; runtime still needs simplified resident collision proxies, hover-lane width, and mission markers that match these coordinates.
